notes.title: Version 1.1 - Smokey's Rescue Team
notes.content:
Hi there, I've been busy updating the game and I believe we've made some real improvements here. Now the game is becoming more stable we should abe able to look forward to adding additional mechanics and levels going into the future. 

Thank you for your patience while I have been fixing the numerous issues.

Please get in touch if there remains an issue that you would like to be fixed immediately.

- Fixed Cat Navigation and input errors
- Updated UI to be more user-friendly
- Updated sounds to be more realistic
- Fixed bugs relating to Adpoters
- Added Tips notifications
- Added quick access Bar
- Added mouse sensitivity option
- Fixed Breed options to more accurately reflect the cats
- Added internal behaviors to the cats
- Added additional options for players to interact with cats
